mapper.select: select tr.id as tr_id, tr.tenant_id as tr_tenant_id, tr.request_id as tr_request_id, tr.trigger_type as tr_trigger_type, tr.job_code as tr_job_code, tr.biz_date as tr_biz_date, tr.dedup_key as tr_dedup_key, tr.request_status as tr_request_status, tr.related_job_instance_id as tr_related_job_instance_id, tr.trace_id as tr_trace_id, tr.created_at as tr_created_at, tr.updated_at as tr_updated_at, tr.dry_run as tr_dry_run, ji.id as ji_id, ji.trigger_request_id as ji_trigger_request_id, ji.instance_no as ji_instance_no, ji.trace_id as ji_trace_id from batch.trigger_request tr left join lateral ( select candidate.id, candidate.trigger_request_id, candidate.instance_no, candidate.trace_id from batch.job_instance candidate where candidate.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and candidate.dedup_key = tr.dedup_key order by candidate.run_attempt desc limit 1 ) ji on true where tr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and tr.request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update batch.trigger_request set request_status = #{requestStatus}, related_job_instance_id = #{relatedJobInstanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and ( request_status not in ('LAUNCHED', 'REJECTED', 'DUPLICATE') or ( request_status = 'LAUNCHED' and #{requestStatus} = 'LAUNCHED' and related_job_instance_id is null and #{relatedJobInstanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT} is not null ) )
mapper.select: select tr.tenant_id as tenant_id, tr.request_id as request_id, ji.id as job_instance_id from batch.trigger_request tr join batch.job_instance ji on ji.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and ji.trigger_request_id = tr.id where tr.request_status = 'ACCEPTED' and tr.related_job_instance_id is null and tr.created_at < #{olderThan} -- audit fix(HIGH-1 静默丢作业):只回写"真正派发过"的实例。launch 的 T1(建 instance=CREATED)与 -- T2(派发 partition/outbox + 推进状态)分属两段独立事务;若 T2 崩溃,instance 滞留 CREATED 且零 -- partition。原查询不过滤状态,会把这种滞留实例也 JOIN 进来、经 reconcileLaunched 谎报成 LAUNCHED, -- 掩盖"作业从未真跑"。排除 CREATED 后,滞留实例保留为陈旧 ACCEPTED → 进入 ADR-010 既定的"过期 -- ACCEPTED 告警 + 人工/恢复"路径,而非被静默闭环。 and ji.instance_status <> 'CREATED' order by tr.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update batch.trigger_request set request_status = 'LAUNCHED', related_job_instance_id = #{jobInstanceId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and request_status = 'ACCEPTED' and related_job_instance_id is null

update batch.trigger_request set request_status = 'LAUNCHED', related_job_instance_id = #{jobInstanceId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and request_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'DUPLICATE') and (related_job_instance_id is null or related_job_instance_id = #{jobInstanceId})
